title: No Surprise From OPEC
summary:
Oil Producer organization extends production cuts
To nobody's surprise, OPEC extended its oil production cuts on November 30. The original cuts, which were agreed exactly one year ago on November 30, 2016, were for 6 months (January - June 2017) and were subsequently extended for 9 months (through March 2018). The new agreement will run through the end of 2018.
